responsibility: This autogenerated companion to bpf.opt maps each BPF target command-line option to its GCC manual anchor. It does not implement option parsing itself; instead it supplies the option-to-documentation URL suffix table used by GCC’s generated diagnostics/help infrastructure so BPF-specific switches like endianness, CO-RE, ISA feature toggles, mcpu, and inlining thresholds can be linked back to the eBPF options documentation.
